title: shipped 5 PRs
summary: wired BYOP and media uploads into the ai dungeon master and product packaging apps. added dirtberry & claude to the model roster. changelogs now load dynamically from the news branch, so you can watch us ship in real time

highlights.title: New Models: Claude & Dirtberry
highlights.text: Claude Sonnet 4.6 is now available via the `claude-airforce` text endpoint, alongside `dirtberry` for quick realistic image generation. Hit the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai) to try them out.

highlights.title: Bring Your Own Pollen
highlights.text: The Product Packaging Designer and AI Dungeon Master community apps now support Pollinations SSO. Log in, spend your own Pollen balance, and bypass third-party media hosts with our native upload service. [View repos](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/tree/main/apps)
